questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c57da6c2af9e2089fc61abf29129773483c793cec3f7ef2032243405349b5f1e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• RNJF → R - 4 = N; N - 4 = J; J - 4 = F
 
• XTPL → X - 4 = T; T - 4 = P; P - 4 = L
 
• MIEA → M - 4 = I; I - 4 = E; E - 4 = A
 
• **TPLI → T - 4 = P; P - 4 = L; L - 3 = I**

Hence, '**TPLI**' is the odd one out.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All grills are ovens.

II. Some tandoors are grills.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tandoors are oven.

II. All ovens are tandoor.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f34eb347a6de60aac96da7dfb861477a612a541a60ed7ca54144f66b22374090.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tandoors are oven. → Follows (As, All grills are ovens and Some tandoors are grills → Some tandoors are oven is definitely follow)

II. All ovens are tandoor. → Do not follow (As, All grills are ovens and Some tandoors are grills → Some ovens are tandoor, All ovens are tandoor is possible but not definitely follow )

Hence, **Only conclusion I follows**.

questions.question: 'Monarch’ is related to ‘Butterfly’ in the same way as ‘Mamba’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 'Monarch’ is related to ‘Butterfly’ → The **monarch butterfly** or simply monarch is a milkweed butterfly in the family Nymphalidae.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Mamba’ is related to ‘________’ → **Mambas** are fast moving highly venomous **snakes** of the genus Dendroaspis in the family Elapidae.

Hence, '**Snake**' is the correct answer.
